name: Madgicx Facebook MCP
description:
Madgicx brings your Facebook advertising into Claude, so you can review performance and act on it in the same conversation.

Ask about your accounts in plain language — how retargeting performed last week, which ads are burning budget with the weakest return, how a campaign trended after a budget change — and Claude pulls the numbers live from your connected ad accounts. Insights are available at account, campaign, ad set, and ad level, with breakdowns across the dimensions you'd normally dig for in Ads Manager.

You can also change things. The connector can start and pause campaigns, ad sets, and ads; set daily and lifetime budgets; adjust bids and spending limits; and rename objects. It can list your connected ad accounts, pull account details and activity logs, and inspect ad creatives individually or in batches.

Typical uses:

Weekly and monthly performance reviews without exporting a report
Finding underperformers across a large account and pausing them
Shifting budget between ad sets based on what the data shows
Auditing recent account changes through activity logs
Investigating creative-level performance across campaigns


Requirements: a Madgicx account on an active subscription or trial, an active workspace, and at least one Facebook ad account connected in Madgicx settings. Authentication is handled through Madgicx; Claude never sees your Facebook credentials.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Madgicx Facebook MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Madgicx Facebook MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.madgicx.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Madgicx Facebook MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Madgicx Facebook MCP lists 56 MCP tools, including add_text_to_ad_name, add_text_to_adset_name, add_text_to_campaign_name, decrease_adset_bid, decrease_adset_budget, decrease_adset_spending_limit, decrease_campaign_budget, get_ad, get_ad_account, get_ad_account_activities, get_ad_account_insights, and get_ad_accounts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Madgicx Facebook MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Madgicx Facebook MCP in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does Madgicx Facebook MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Madgicx Facebook MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Madgicx Facebook MCP is developed by Madgicx. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
